semiconductor_relevance: High — Japan Fine Materials specializes in ceramic spare parts for semiconductor manufacturing equipment, making them relevant suppliers in the semiconductor industry.
summary: Japan Fine Materials is a specialized trading company that provides ceramic spare parts for semiconductor manufacturing equipment and metal/resin parts for medical applications. They offer comprehensive services from material procurement to product sales and after-sales support, focusing on quality and timely delivery.
capabilities: Ceramic spare parts for semiconductor manufacturing equipment
Metal and resin parts for medical applications
Precision machining including cutting, turning, and polishing
Complex shape manufacturing through various molding techniques

regional_presence.Japan: The company sources materials from qualified suppliers in Japan and has a focus on integrating manufacturing capabilities within the region.
